summary: Origin Agritech Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of a Senior Convertible Promissory Note to an individual investor. The note has a principal amount of RMB 15,000,000 (~US$2,050,000), bearing 3.98% interest, maturing three years from the final funding date. The investor may convert into ordinary shares at US$1.50 per share, with a six-month lock-up on conversion shares. Proceeds go to operating affiliate Hainan Aoyu Biotechnology for working capital. This is a financing event, not a special situation; watch for potential dilution from future conversion.
